notes.title: MEs 2024.1.2
notes.content:
Greetings fellow humans!

How is January almost at an end already? The time flew by, maybe because we were working on another fun update for you all. 🥰 This brings some features that we’re super duper happy to share with you, alongside some bug fixes that provide for a smoother MEs experience. Read on ahead for more info!

[h1] New Features [/h1]

[h2] Nameplates [/h2]

Traversing the online worlds of MEs? Working together with a small team on a project? Losing yourself in a creative vortex? Today’s feature is for you! (and anyone else reading this) 

With nameplates, your username will be displayed above your MEs Chan for everyone else to see and know who you are!

[h2] Camera Spring Arm [/h2]

The camera movement in MEs is more fluid now and isn’t rigidly stuck to MEs Chan. Experience the smooth nature of third person movement across our worlds! 

[h2] Patch Placement Adjustments [/h2]

While in a patch placement state, you can hold the V and F keys to move patches closer/further away from you. We hope this additional functionality enables you more creative control over your MEs world designs moving forward. 

[h1] Bug Fixes & Improvements [/h1]

[list]
[*] ESC key functionality is no longer blocked by the Brush Tool being open.
[*] You can now interact with a Browser Patch even if you didn’t place it.
[*] Ctrl [Windows] & Cmd [Mac] keys now also work for multi selection in the MIND.
[*] MEs should no longer require double clicking of keyboard buttons to perform any functionality.
[*] MEs Chan will respawn as expected after multiple despawns. 
[*] Videos in the Manual World should now play consistently.
[*] The multiline text entry in the Text Chat has been adjusted to work without spaces.
[*] Visual adjustments to SFC & Gallery001 Worlds.
[/list]

That’s all for today folks! Thank you for reading and for playing MEs! We have upcoming events taking place live in MEs so keep an eye on our socials for any announcements.

Have a good start to February,

O Ltd

notes.title: MEs 2024.1.1
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone! We hope you all had a good start to the new year and are getting back into the swing of things in 2024 😊

As for MEs, we have our first update of the year to share with you all, so read on ahead for the tasty patch notes and the fixes to MEs! (Note: do not actually print and eat this without consulting a doctor first)

[h1] Bug Fixes & Improvements [/h1]

[list]
[*] General backend improvements to MEs.
[*] Casting and inspecting patches in the Keio SFC Twin Campus world works as expected.
[*] Patch uploading was improved to prevent uploading corrupt files which would crash MEs. 
[*] Set the default window size to “windowed” on Mac to prevent a crash when alt-tabbing.
[*] File picker will only show files types supported by MEs when importing to the MIND.
[*] Adjusted the Text & Browser patch material exposure to improve readability.
[*] Removed a rogue plane that made it’s way into the Higher Garden world.
[*] Camera zoom has been disabled in the MIND when placing a text patch.
[*] Multi line support implemented within the Text Chat input window.
[*] Deleting multiple selected patches from the MIND works as intended.
[*] Added a notification about our servers being at capacity when trying to join a cloud world. 
[*] MIND will import the correct patch after deleting a different patch.
[*] You can no longer stack multiple messages during the login process.
[*] Repeated login requests should no longer be occurring on the same machine. 
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

[list]
[*] If a patch fails to upload to a cloud world, it will get removed from the MIND. Please re-import your patch into the MIND when this happens.
[/list]

As always, there’s more fixes, improvements and new features incoming. Please keep an eye on our Discord server for upcoming events later this month.

We’re very excited for everything we have planned this year, and hope you join us for our virtual adventures.

Keep on creating! 

O Ltd

notes.title: MEs 2023.12.3
notes.content:
Oh hello again! As mentioned in our previous update, we have one more world we wanted to share with you before the end of the year! Read on ahead for our latest artist collaboration, and for a sneak peak of upcoming features and changes to MEs in early 2024!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]My Magic Laboratory - Artist Open Studio Series[/h2]

Our last world for 2023 invites you to explore a room of someone who refuses to give up on pursuing magic. Designed by [url=https://twitter.com/Shinanashina]Shina[/url], let “My Magic Laboratory” take you on a journey we’re all too familiar with - nights obsessively spent researching and looking to bring some magic into our lives ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904047/94caf434e1bd5e3822aba52e1a912d31389f0f85.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Loading state added to Create World button
[*] Added MIND related hotkeys to the UI for easier navigation
[*] ESC key will close the Invite a Friend window
[*] Adjustments to Text Chat functionality
[/list]

That’s it for MEs updates for 2023! 
Thank you all very much for sticking with us, providing us with feedback, and interacting with MEs. We will be taking some time to focus on bug fixes, core improvements and the aforementioned collaboration features in MEs. You’ll hear from us again in January.

Have a fun, safe and creative end to your year - see you in the next one!

O Ltd

notes.content:
Welcome to December and welcome to another MEs update! 

We are excited to share some more worlds from our Artist Open Studio Series. Spend some time in by the pixelated sea side, or let your thoughts wonder in a gallery of fragments… Onto the update notes!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Sea0Side and Lotus Pond World - Artist Open Studio Series[/h2]

Two new worlds designed by [url=https://twitter.com/bnt369]Binetsu[/url] have appeared in MEs! Experience MEs in the 1 bit dimension as you unwind by the sea or walk amongst the lotus ponds.

[list]
[*] You can now quit the application from the login screen
[*] Improved cursor state when hovering over a button
[*] Button loading state added to indicate when MEs is loading data
[*] Background Music improvements and adjustments

[*] Fixed Foliage in Gallery001 world

We’re still investigating the known issues found in the links below, and we also have a very exciting set of features coming soon to MEs. Can’t wait to share more with you 😊

notes.title: MEs 2023.11.2
notes.content:
Hey hey hello and happy Monday!

Today’s update continues our long standing tradition established just last week 😅

We’re very proud and excited to share a World that’s been in the works for a couple of months now. Let’s not delay any further, onto the update!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Keio University Shonan Fujisawa Campus Digital Twin World[/h2]

This digital twin world is our most technically and visually impressive world yet, created directly in collaboration with Keio University and Softbank. The concept behind the world was to create a computational knowledge base playground — to build and expand upon the last 33 years of SFC and its projects. Students and faculty members can shape the school’s culture by treating the world as a blank canvas, but everyone is welcome to peruse, and experience a digital twin of this sophisticated and modern university campus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904047/eee382c3a8e735cd4ee447f625f5c7d9cef9fa35.png[/img]

[h2]Japanese Localization[/h2]

MEs has been fully translated into Japanese! You can change your language between English and Japanese in the settings, and interact with MEs how you prefer! 

[h2]World Controls Dropdown Menu[/h2]

You can access all the world controls from a dropdown menu. This will be expanded in the future with additional functionality and options for all your handy world management.

[h2]Thanking our supporters[/h2]

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to our supporters on [url=https://www.patreon.com/MEsbyO]Patreon[/url] You can find a dedicated credits wall in the Manual World which we will update with each release. 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Minor updates and fixes to MEs chan skins
[*] Audio patch Play/Pause no longer restarts the audio
[*] No audio rolloff when placing an audio patch
[*] Text patch auto focused keyboard input on creation
[*] Search auto focuses keyboard input on open
[*] World Browser visual updates
[*] Adjusted Avatar images in profile screen
[*] Fixed manual world ambient audio
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

Placing patches in a cloud SFC World is only possible by using the Search (”Tab” key) function. Casting from the MIND will not work. A local SFC World works as expected.

Due to a Mac related update, your local worlds won’t display in the World Browser on a Mac. Cloud worlds are not affected in the same way so if you want to ensure no progress will be lost, create a Cloud World. We’re working to get this resolved as fast as possible and apologize for the inconvenience 🙇‍♂️ 

Placing Audio patches in cloud worlds can cause severe crashes. While we investigate the cause & fix it is recommended to not place any audio patches in cloud worlds for the time being. 

Using AirPods on a Mac will cause MEs to crash. We are investigating this issue, but for now recommend keeping your AirPods disconnected from Mac when launching MEs.

That’s all for this week! See you again soon for more updates! 

Take care, 

O Ltd

notes.title: MEs 2023.11.1
notes.content:
Oh hi there! 

We hope you’ve been well and had a spooky Halloween!

We are very thrilled for today’s update, it’s the start of something we’ve been working on for a long time, and we are proud to unveil it to you today. Let’s get right into the update log.

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Cloud Ovum World - Artist Open Studio Series[/h2]

We are thrilled to unveil our first world created in collaboration with an artist! Designed by [url=https://www.instagram.com/miqhan/]MIQ[/url], the Cloud Ovum World invites you to experience life as a vessel floating above the clouds. Please look forward to more artist world releases in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904047/7b9e49ac3608ac7051890db473c2418b2c9ac670.jpg[/img]

[h2]Manual World[/h2]

For all newcomers to MEs - learn how to use MEs while playing MEs! Create your own Manual World to learn the controls, interactions and functions of MEs by yourself or with your friends online! Revisit it any time to remind & refresh your memory.
To access the manual world:
[olist]
[*] Open MEs
[*] Once loaded press “Q” to open the menu
[*] Navigate to “WORLDS”
[*] Click “Add World”
[*] Select the Manual World, create and enter the world
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904047/9ab983e75949f0bae9f931aed7c6574a5467660e.png[/img]

[h2]World Browser[/h2]

The WORLDS menu is now split into two separate tabs; FEATURED WORLDS and MY WORLDS. My Worlds functions just as how you’re used to it - you can find a collection of the worlds you created. The Featured Worlds tab will be updated to a hub in the future for a variety of world categories, but for now you can learn more below. 

[h3]Featured Worlds[/h3]

Featured Worlds are worlds anyone within MEs can access - no access code is necessary! Jump in and experience these worlds with other players. Please note that all featured worlds are set to view only. You will not be able to place or move any patches. You can expect many more featured worlds in the future…

[h3]UI Updates[/h3]

In addition to a fade in animation for all worlds in the World Browser, cloud worlds will display a cloud icon to differentiate them from local worlds. The World creator’s username will also be displayed below the world title in the browser.

[h3]Text Patch Improvements[/h3]

Both types of text patch are now double sided! You will no longer be surprised by a text patch appearing suddenly - it will clearly announce it’s existence no matter which way it’s facing. Additionally, the camera will ignore the text patch and not zoom unexpectedly when walking through a text patch. 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] MEs process correctly terminates on Quit
[*] Camera no longer collides with patches in the MIND
[*] The date on worlds and text patches doesn’t set itself to 1970 anymore
[*] World Details no longer gray out when viewing other worlds
[*] Rotation axis don’t reset on each right click
[*] Edited opacity in the profile menu
[*] Increased base size of browser patch
[*] Fixed MEs chan collision on browser patch
[*] Rotation tool displays correctly on browser patch
[/list]

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]

Aside from the features mentioned in the last Steam update, you can expect to be hearing from us about this in the near-ish future:

[h2]More Featured Worlds[/h2]

Now that we have this fancy new menu we should probably keep filling it with new worlds and collaborations… Expect more soon! If you know someone, or are building something yourself and would like to integrate it into MEs - we want to hear from you! Please contact us at community@o-me.io.  

[h2]Communication Methods[/h2]

When you play with others online, ideally you want to be able to communicate together. Rest assured, systems for this are in the works.

Thank you so much for sticking with us and for reading through these patch notes! 

See you all virtually!

O Ltd

notes.title: MEs 2023.10.1
notes.content:
Hello lovely people!

As the months are getting colder, it’s the perfect time to get cozy and creative! Since the update last month, we’ve been busy at work on new features, fixes, and some cool future plans to help you achieve those comfy winter creation vibes. 🥰 Read on for changes below!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Simple Text Patch[/h2]

When first placing a Text Box Patch, you will now be presented with the Simple Text Patch first. This lets you put text in the world without any background. Make your text pop and comment on your surroundings! (Tip: Emojis also work!)

You can still access the original, larger text box by clicking the Text Box button.

[h2]New Worlds[/h2]

[h3]Fantastic Desert[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904047/c5f166f065d5e999f797b544250714bb58c02050.png[/img]
Originally featured in the 2023 [url=https://avex.jp/en/meetyourart/festival/]MEET YOUR ART FESTIVAL[/url] art exhibition, the Fantastic Desert is now accessible by all MEs users! Peruse the crystal glistening desert and let your mind wander amidst the absence…

[h1]Updates and Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Multiplayer Collision[/h2]

MEs Chan can now collide with image and model patches in multiplayer cloud worlds! Climb towers of your own creations, jump on tables or beds or whatever other 3D object you import! Cross a bridge, walk up some stairs, or slope your images to walk upon your art.  

[h2]Brush Tool Fixes[/h2]

The Brush Tool has been re-examined and refactored to work as expected both in both multiplayer and single player.

[h2]Patches Disappearing[/h2]

There was an occasional gnarly issue of your patches turning invisible in the MIND and in WORLDS - no more!

[h2]Rotation Feature[/h2]

The Rotation Feature receives another face lift! While rotating you will now see a rotation widget to help you understand the rotation axis. While holding down the right mouse button, press the 1, 2, and 3 keys on your keyboard to switch rotation axis. You can also press “R” to reset the rotation back to it’s default position

[h2]Updated UI Look[/h2]

Our user interface now has stylish rounded edges for your viewing pleasure.

[h2]WORLD Detail Menu Opens Before WORLD Load[/h2]

You can now preview WORLD information before you enter - ensure you’re joining the right world and avoid an unexpected surprise! 

[h2]Patch Placement Camera Update[/h2]

The camera enters a focused mode while placing a patch to allow for finer control and more overview. 

[h1]Bug Fix Changelist[/h1]

[list]
[*] Disabled collision on patch selection pin and audio patches
[*] Added SFX audio slider, WORLD ambience sounds included with SFX
[*] Updated Key Bindings page
[*] Crash fixes
[*] Updated Discord link to not expire
[*] Fixed patch file size limit message
[*] New and updated icons
[*] Text box patches now display the correct username
[*] Default quality set to High instead of Epic
[*] Scale is correctly replicated in cloud worlds
[*] Multitude of performance improvements
[*] Patch asset loading refactor - should lead to faster load times between MIND <> WORLD
[*] Entering WORLD no longer requires two clicks
[*] General backend improvements to smooth future development
[/list]

[h1]What’s next?[/h1]

[h2]Tutorial World[/h2]

A tutorial world to introduce new users to MEs and it’s functionality is in the late development progress.

[h2]New Worlds[/h2]

We mentioned collaborating with artists in the patch notes above… Hopefully that’s enough of an indicator for what’s to come next. Keep those eyes peeled! 👀

[h2]Privacy controls[/h2]

We have implemented the backend to support this functionality, the next step is to feature some view only worlds. More on this soon!

[h2]Server Improvements[/h2]

A lot of time over the next month will be dedicated to server improvements to ensure more people can use MEs - don’t worry, there’ll still be a stream of new features and improvements!

That’s it for this edition of your MEs patch notes.

Hope you’ve all been well and healthy,

Till next time!

O Ltd

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Hello again!

We thought we’d squeeze in some quick updates and fixes that couldn’t [i]quite[/i] make it into the release on Wednesday. Patch notes below!

[h3]MEs Chan animation fix[/h3]

While her old shuffle walk was kind of adorable, MEs Chan now animates her walk and jump correctly! 

[h3]Rotation Update[/h3]

The rotation system received some more attention - you can now rotate on a third axis by holding down the shift key. Additionally, all rotation is based on the patch rather than the camera allowing for more intuitive control. 

[h3]UI Fixes[/h3]

Worlds added to the world browser were previously appearing twice. This is no longer the case! 

[h3]Hotkey WORLD<>MIND Transition[/h3]

You can now use the Z key to transition interchangeably between WORLD and MIND.

That’s it for today 🙂
As always, more updates are in the works! Please refer to the previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2361710/view/3743110574772999390]Steam Update[/url] for a hint at what’s to come.

Keep on creating,

O Ltd

notes.title: MEs 2023.9.1 - Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Hey there everyone! 

We’re thrilled to bring you the latest update to MEs, bringing you some features we’re very excited about. Read below for the new features, changes and fixes included in this update.

Unfortunately bringing you all these updates comes at the cost of the data currently in MEs. Due to the nature of Early Access development any files you had previously in the MIND, and any worlds you created will be inaccessible after updating. We apologize for any inconvenience - to stay up to date with any announcements please join our Discord server (links below). 

Now, onto the fun stuff!

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]

You can now explore Worlds and place patches together with others! When creating a new world, pick the [b]Cloud World[/b] option to receive a shareable access key. Enter this key in the Join World menu to collaborate with others. You can still make private worlds by picking [b]Local World[/b] during world creation.

[h3]User Profile[/h3]

When you first launch MEs after updating, you will need to create a user profile by entering your email address. Afterwards, you can set your user name and user ID. The username will be visible to others as you explore the metaverses in future releases, whilst the user ID is a hint at things to come in the future….

[h3]Starter Pack[/h3]

We have prepared some 3D Models to get you started in MEs. You can download them [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hlvrGSNaK68IdtlQlEE9QUqQa4J4lP6i?usp=sharing]here[/url] and import them into your mind so you’re not starting from 0 assets.

[h2]Updates, Fixes, Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Settings Menu Links[/h3]

We’ve added some handy links to directly share your feedback with us or report a bug. We’d greatly appreciate your help in shaping the future of MEs together!

[h3]UI Overhaul[/h3]

A majority of our UI backend got a facelift. While a lot of these changes might be invisible to the player - they’ll make future UI implementations much easier.

[h3]Rotation Widget[/h3]

Rotating your patches is not only easier, it also displays a helpful guide so you always know which axis you’re currently rotating. You can also hold down the right mouse button to reset the position.

[h2]Known Issues/Planned Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Patch Placement[/h3]

The patch placement system will be receiving an overhaul in order to provide you with more control when designing your worlds.

[h3]Patch Collisions[/h3]

Patch collisions can be inconsistent when patches are sloped and during multiplayer. 

[h3]Patch Uploads[/h3]

Patches disappear briefly whilst they’re being uploaded to the server when placing a patch in a cloud world.

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]

[h3]Tutorial World[/h3]

A tutorial world to introduce new users to MEs and it’s functionality is in the implementation process.

[h3]New Worlds[/h3]

Some new worlds we are very excited to share with you are closer on the horizon than you might think…

[h3]Privacy Controls[/h3]

A suite of permission controls allowing creators to specify who & how others can interact with their worlds and patches is in the design stage.

[h3]Communication System[/h3]

We are in the early planning stages for a system allowing communication in multiplayer worlds.

[h3]Fixes, Updates, and Improvements[/h3]

We will continue to improve MEs in between bigger feature releases. Please share your feedback with us in our Discord server or via the feedback forms found in the MEs settings menu - we greatly appreciate your help!

Thank you for reading our patch notes, now go let your creativity be free!

O Ltd

notes.title: MEs 2023.6.1
notes.content:
Hello, MEs creators, we hope all of your summers are off to a great start as we bring you this latest update to MEs!

Version 2023.6.1 includes these new updates:
[list]
[*]Unreal 5.2: MEs is now running off the latest release of the Unreal Engine! This upgrade allowed us to fix some existing bugs, as well as to bring support to Apple Silicon devices.
[*]New Seed World: Explore the beautiful new world, Under the Light, "a research laboratory for faint life forms".
[*]Patch Rotation: The previous version of patch placement did not allow for rotating the patch to certain orientations. Now, while holding the right mouse button, you'll be able to smoothly rotate the patch in all 3 axes.
[*]Patch Collision: Additionally, all placed patches now have collision enabled. Use your imported objects to create stairs and bridges to reach new heights and corners of your worlds!
[*]Batch Import: When importing files to the Mind, you can now select multiple files to import at once.
[/list]
Thank you all for your continued feedback and support. We'll soon begin testing multiplayer worlds through the Early Access updates, so for any creators that are interested in getting more involved and helping us test, please check out the Discord for the latest news!

notes.title: MEs 2023.5.2
notes.content:
Hello from O you beautiful people! We have another update for MEs that we hope will improve your overall idea organization experience.

[list]
[*]We have added the ability to Move a patch after its initial placement. All you need to do is approach it in your Metaverse world until it is selectable, then press P. We have further improvements to this feature coming soon so watch this space.
[*]If you travel to the Settings Menu via our Pie Menu, you are now able to select a new location on your Hard drive to store your MEs files. Just be sure to select an empty folder to prevent overwriting anything else that already exists there. And don't go renaming those files that MEs is storing for you, or it will lose track of them.
[*]We also have several UI improvements and bug fixes that are always being caught thanks to everyone's great feedback so be sure to keep it coming. These include fixes to the Pie Menu animations, and an anti-alias issue for Text Patches and URL Patches.
[/list]
Thank you so much for taking the time keeping up to date with MEs and we will see you next update!

notes.title: First Major + Minor Update
notes.content:
[h1]Regular Update v.2023.04.1[/h1]

• In addition to the current image, audio, text, and 3D model patches, you can now add URL patches into your world. Create one using the URL button in the Mind, enter any web address, then cast it into your world as an interactive web browser.
• If you've already added files and started building worlds in MEs, we've implemented database migration to make sure your data doesn't get lost as we continue to update the app.
• Worlds can now also be deleted from the World Browser.
• Various UI improvements have been made throughout the menus, HUD, and patch inspect views.
• Metaverse patches can now also be selected and deleted with keyboard shortcuts (Del and Backspace keys by default) in addition to using the trash can icon when inspecting the patch.
• A 25MB file size limit is now in place when importing all patch types.
• Audio patch playback can now be started and stopped from the inspect view.

And here are some of the major bugs we've fixed:
• Image patches now import with correct rotation instead of appearing flipped.
• World Browser icons now correctly show a screenshot of the world instead of black texture.
• Removed the sound effect on settings audio slider.
• Fixed issues with taking screenshots in the metaverse.
• Audio patches are now no longer able to be used with the Brush.

We're also keeping the user manual updated as we go, so please check it out as you continue to explore MEs!
[url=https://oltd.notion.site/MEs-Creator-Manual-76be9ca2ba124600a1655d852c8de509]https://oltd.notion.site/MEs-Creator-Manual-76be9ca2ba124600a1655d852c8de509[/url]


[h1]Minor Update v.2023.04.02[/h1]
• Japanese input support. We now support Hiragana, Katakana and most Kanji characters.
• Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean and Arabic support for Unicode characters
• Emoji input support (limited)
• Fixed a behavior in the URL patch which stopped the user from being able to move while using the browser in inspect mode. A 3D cursor is also now visible.
• Fixed a bug that triggered player death when walking on water in the Light Room world.
• Loading screen now shows the version number of MEs

We're excited to roll out more minor updates as and when they're done, so stay tuned for more updates! 💚
